clo_details: Explain the fundamental research methods and approaches and how they can be applied in academic or professional contexts.
Compare and contrast qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including sampling methods and data collection techniques, to assess their suitability for different research contexts.

Develop a comprehensive research proposal that integrates historical perspectives, appropriate methodologies, ethical considerations, and strategies for publication and evaluation in Information and Communication Science and Technology.
Develop sophisticated argument essays through critical analysis, ethical sourcing, and anti-plagiarism, forming well-founded opinions and thesis statements

Plan and conduct research on an academic topic, following these steps: topic selection, outlining, source gathering, note-taking, maintaining an academic tone, citing sources in MLA format, and avoiding plagiarism. Write a 7-8 page research paper demonstrating proper MLA formatting for source material.
